title: I Let the Recruiter Keep the Calendar Hold Until It Expired On Camera

parts.text: I joined the Zoom at 10:00 a.m. for a slot the recruiter had asked me to hold all week. The room was empty. I was thirty-four, employed, camera on, holding a glass of water. At 10:12 she messaged running from another onsite, can you hold. The hold had already eaten Tuesday and Thursday. I recorded the empty room with the timestamp and the original calendar invite that said 30 minutes. Then I left at 10:30 on the dot. At 10:31 she joined and asked why I was unprofessional.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: She entered at 10:31 calling me unprofessional for leaving a 10:00 hold.

social.video_title: All-week hold, empty Zoom, 10:31 entrance — Part 1/2
social.description: Camera on, water, two days eaten. The invite said 30 minutes. Would you have stayed?

parts.text: I sent the timestamp recording to her and to the hiring email on the invite. The hiring manager apologized and offered a real slot. I declined because all-week holds are a culture. She kept the calendar. I kept Tuesday. Unprofessional is a word for leaving at the end time. Empty rooms are not interviews. Water helped. The next recruiter got a 45-minute window, once. I do not hold weeks. Weeks are for work I already have.

social.video_title: The hiring email got the empty-room timestamp — Part 2/2
social.description: Declined the makeup, kept Tuesday, culture noted. Was a hold a job?
